title: Why Do We Overthink Until We Get Sick? (1982-06-01)
description:
Constantly worrying about the future or trapped in overthinking? Discover how your thoughts affect your body and how to awaken your inner peace.

This public program explains the subtle system, revealing how extreme thinking and futuristic planning cause physical and emotional exhaustion. It covers the root of psychosomatic diseases and culminates in a guided meditation to experience the Kundalini awakening on your own nervous system.

Key Topics:
• ☀️ The danger of living in the future - how overthinking and constant planning drain your emotional energy and damage the liver
• 🔬 Understanding psychosomatic health - the subtle connection between extreme left or right-sided imbalances and modern diseases
• 💬 Q&A insights - understanding why true yoga is a spontaneous, living process rather than forced physical exercises or mental effort
• ⚡ Guided Self-Realization - a practical meditation session to feel the cool breeze of your Kundalini awakening on your fingertips

“But when you touch it, when your consciousness touches it, the light of that universal being starts coming inside us. And when that light gets within us we get enlightened.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Sahaja yoga, if I have to tell somebody, how will I define it in one or two sentences?
• Do you recommend the practice of Hatha yoga? The practice of asanas and so on.?
• But still you have to learn it, it doesn't come spontaneously, without learning?
• These vibrations, how do they move?
• At what time it may come?
• So what we do to remove the hindrances to this connection?
• And the connection inevitably will be established?
• Will the vibrations cure someone? What exactly happens?
• What is wrong with me?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How does overthinking affect the liver and physical health?
• What is the spiritual cause of psychosomatic diseases?
• How to stop being anxious about the future spiritually?

Do you find yourself constantly planning for the future at the expense of your peace today? Did you feel the cool breeze during the meditation?
